messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — multiple SRV lookup failures observed from services in us-west-2b. High error rate (5xx / DNS NX) for internal service discovery. Root hits threshold.

oncall-alex: ack — taking. seeing alerts in PagerDuty. tagging #incidents.
sre-jen: I can see spikes in CoreDNS pods in us-west-2b OOM/kick restarts, and Consul health is flapping. quick check: `kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l k8s-app=coredns -o wide` shows margin.

infra-raj: digging into node network paths — noticed a few ENI detach/attach events in AZ b from cloud provider logs around the same timeframe. Could be noisy and causing packet loss to kubelets.
support-maria: any customer impact seen? Support queue getting 10+ tickets saying "service discovery failing" for integrations that call internal endpoints.

oncall-alex: short term: I'll shift traffic away from us-west-2b by adjusting our smart routing policy to prefer us-west-2a/c for internal RPCs (non-stateful) and enable fallback for SRV resolution to cached entries for 2m. Deploying policy change now.
sre-jen: +1 for routing. Also suggest temporarily increase CoreDNS replica counts in us-west-2b to route around restarts while we root cause. I'm seeing CoreDNS containers crash with:```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
  at github.com/coredns/plugin/serve.go:123
stack trace...
```

infra-raj: Provider incident shows brief control-plane degraded in us-west-2b — several BGP flaps and one network maintenance window that wasn't flagged to us. Reaching out to provider ops.

eng-nick: What about Consul? If SRV lookups fail and Consul agents are flapping, clients will get NX. `consul members` from a healthy node shows ~40% of agents in RECONNECT state in us-west-2b. Running `consul leave` / `consul join` might help, but prefer to avoid churn.

oncall-alex: Action list: 1) apply routing rule to prefer other AZs (done). 2) scale CoreDNS to +2 replicas in us-west-2b (in progress). 3) enable KV-cached SRV fallback for 2m TTL. 4) open support ticket with provider (raj). 5) monitor customer impact and notify PMs.

pm-liz: Please loop me in on affected customers and any SLI/alert thresholds hit. We need to assess potential credits.
support-maria: Current impacted customers count estimate: ~12 orgs show increased error rates; 3 have reported production impact to support. Logging shows spike in failed SRV lookups for `svc.internal.redwood` between 15:04–15:18 UTC.

sre-jen: Routing change rolled out; I can confirm decreased error rate on control plane calls in us-west-2b to 8% from 35% in the last 5m. CoreDNS scale completed. CoreDNS pod restarts stopped after new image rolled (hotfix) to catch an edge nil pointer in plugin chain.

eng-nick: Hotfix details: bumped coredns to 1.8.7-hotfix with defensive nil checks. Release command:```bash
kubectl -n kube-system set image deployment/coredns coredns=coredns:1.8.7-hotfix
```
All pods passed readiness.

infra-raj: Provider confirmed a transient fabric noisy neighbor + partial control-plane maintenance in us-west-2b that affected ENI stability. They pushed a mitigation and said they'll provide RCA.

oncall-alex: Customer impact summary for now: transient SRV lookup failures in us-west-2b due to combined CoreDNS crash loop and underlying ENI instability. We mitigated by routing traffic away from the AZ, scaling and patching CoreDNS, and enabling SRV fallback caching. Estimated customer-reachable window: ~14 minutes (15:04–15:18 UTC).

pm-liz: Thanks. Please collect timelines and config diffs for the postmortem. Assigning follow-up to SRE squad — need root cause and action to avoid AZ fragility.

sre-jen: Will own postmortem. Initial RCA hypothesis: CoreDNS nil pointer crash triggered by malformed response under packet loss -> resp handler didn't gate nil upstream; combined with ENI flaps led to amplification.

support-maria: Notifying affected customers with a short note and ETA for RCA.

oncall-alex: Handoff to infra-raj for monitoring provider updates and postmortem coordination. I'm going offline for rotation at 16:00 UTC; leaving runbook in the thread.

infra-raj: acked. I'll keep watch and escalate if provider updates change. Also adding ephemeral firewall rule to stick resolver traffic to healthy AZ endpoints for 1h to reduce re-routing churn.

eng-nick: Adding logs snippet for posterity:```
15:05:12 svc-proxy[1234]: dns lookup failed: srv lookup svc.internal.redwood: NXDOMAIN
15:05:13 coredns[78]: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address (nil pointer deref)
15:05:13 coredns[78]: goroutine 1 [running]:
```

incident-bot: Incident auto-update: status -> mitigated. severity -> high -> mitigated. page incidents/1769972461 updated.

oncall-alex: closing loop — mitigation validated, customers informed, postmortem assigned. If anything reoccurs ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
